title: BTS Tops September Advertising Model Brand Reputation Rankings
detail: September 3, 2026 — The Korean Business Research Institute released its September Advertising Model Brand Reputation Rankings, placing BTS first overall, with rookie group RESCENE second and trot star Lim Young-woong third. The index was compiled from 34,915,880 pieces of big data gathered between Aug 3 and Sept 3, weighing participation, media exposure, communication, and community-activity metrics rather than chart performance alone. The result lands during a rest day in the ARIRANG World Tour's Los Angeles stand, between the SoFi Stadium run's first two sold-out shows (Sept 1-2) and its closing two (Sept 5-6).

media.caption: BTS ranks first in the September 2026 advertising model brand reputation rankings.

title: HYBE Chairman Bang Si-hyuk Referred to Prosecutors Over Alleged IPO Fraud
detail: September 3, 2026 — The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's Financial Crime Investigation Unit referred HYBE chairman Bang Si-hyuk and four others, including HYBE CEO Lee Jae-sang and a former CFO, to the Seoul Southern District Prosecutors' Office on suspicion of violating the Capital Markets Act, after a roughly 20-month investigation. Police allege Bang and the co-defendants misled existing shareholders in 2019 by telling them no stock market listing was planned for then-Big Hit Entertainment — while preparations for the October 2020 IPO were already under way — and encouraged them to sell stakes to a private equity fund whose own investors were separately told a listing was coming, generating an estimated 263.1 billion won ($190 million) in alleged improper gains. Bang was referred without detention; a Seoul court had already approved freezing roughly $193 million tied to the case. Prosecutors had twice rejected police requests for an arrest warrant (April and May 2026) before this referral. Bang has denied wrongdoing throughout. HYBE's operations are unaffected: the ARIRANG World Tour continues on schedule and the company posted record Q2 2026 revenue. Prosecutors will now decide whether to indict, order further investigation, or drop the case.

media.caption: HYBE chairman Bang Si-hyuk is referred to prosecutors over alleged IPO-era investor fraud.
